fluff.overview: The Kuan Ti class DropShip is a heavily armed assault vessel developed by the Capellan Confederation for in-system defensive operations. First entering production in 3055, this 2,200-ton aerodyne design packs a devastating array of advanced weaponry and extensive armor protection into a compact and agile hull. The design's origins trace back to a pre-Fourth Succession War research project that was repeatedly delayed by the Confederation's economic and military crises before finally reaching production under a new chancellor's patronage. Despite its formidable combat capability, the Kuan Ti is fundamentally a defensive platform, optimized for system patrol and interdiction rather than extended offensive operations.
fluff.capabilities:
The Kuan Ti concentrates devastating forward firepower in a compact hull. The nose mounts two Gauss rifles, an ER large laser, a large pulse laser, two medium pulse lasers, two standard medium lasers, an Artemis IV-equipped LRM-20, an Artemis IV-equipped SRM-6, and two anti-missile systems. Each wing carries an autocannon/10, an ER large laser, an ER PPC, a large pulse laser, four medium pulse lasers, a standard medium laser, an Artemis IV-equipped LRM-20, and an Artemis IV-equipped SRM-6. The aft arc mounts a large pulse laser, two medium pulse lasers, a standard medium laser, an Artemis IV-equipped LRM-10, an Artemis IV-equipped SRM-6, and two anti-missile systems. Forty-three double heat sinks manage the substantial thermal load.

The vessel carries two small craft bays and approximately 268 tons of cargo. However, the Kuan Ti's most significant limitation is its fuel capacity of only forty-five tons, sufficient for in-system patrol and defense but a severe constraint during extended operations. The anti-missile systems provide point defense but carry extremely limited ammunition, estimated at only two or three bursts per gun. A crew of 47 operates the vessel at a safe thrust of 6g, making the Kuan Ti one of the faster assault DropShips in service.
fluff.deployment: The Kuan Ti serves primarily as a system defense vessel within the Capellan Confederation and Free Worlds League navies. Its limited fuel capacity restricts the vessel to patrol and interdiction operations within a single star system, a deliberate design choice widely interpreted as reflecting the Confederation's priority of defending against another large-scale invasion rather than projecting offensive power beyond its borders.
fluff.history:
Research on the Kuan Ti began at the Earthwerks facility on Ares in 3027, shortly before the Fourth Succession War. The devastating Capellan losses during that conflict halted the project until 3039, when a team of engineers reopened the design files and incorporated rediscovered Star League technology, creating a vessel bearing little resemblance to the original concept. However, the weakness of the Capellan economy and the general scarcity of advanced components made prototype construction impractical, and the project was shelved once more.

The Kuan Ti finally became reality under the new Capellan chancellor, who authorized prototype construction immediately upon assuming power. The prototype completed its maiden flight in mid-3054, with full production commencing in 3055. Initial production compared favorably against rival designs, with approximately a dozen vessels completed or nearing completion within the first production cycle. In a diplomatic gesture accompanying a state marriage alliance, the Confederation shared the design specifications with the Free Worlds League in August 3055. Kallon Industries began producing the Kuan Ti at their Loyalty facility within five months, expanding the vessel's availability to both states and causing considerable anxiety among their neighbors.
